title: Typos in identifier fields do NOT return fuzzy matches
permissions_required: A user with Work Orders access.
preconditions: 2. A Work Order 'S2-15276' exists and no Work Order 'S2-15286' exists.
steps: 1. Type a near-miss Work Order number, for example 'S2-15286' (one digit off from a real WO).
2. Read the results.
expected:
1. The real Work Order 'S2-15276' is NOT returned as a fuzzy match.
